homepage.title: Documenso - The Open Source DocuSign Alternative
homepage.meta_description: Sign everywhere with Documenso. Build workflows, create templates, and integrate seamlessly with tools you love—modern, secure, and customizable for any scale.

notes: No H1 on the homepage — answer engines lean on heading structure to extract claims.
No schema.org JSON-LD found — engines get zero structured facts about the business.
No llms.txt — the emerging standard for handing AI models a curated map of your site.
